Name: Chance-Based Artisan Good Quality
Author: AmishIT
Description:
[i]Chance-Based Artisan Good Quality[/i] allows artisan goods to sometimes inherit the quality of their inputs.

By default, Silver inputs produce Silver outputs 50% of the time, Gold inputs produce Gold outputs 25% of the time, and Iridium inputs produce Iridium outputs 12% of the time. If an item does not retain its input quality, it instead becomes one level lower: Silver inputs produce normal-quality outputs 50% of the time, Gold inputs produce Silver outputs 75% of the time, and Iridium inputs produce Gold outputs 88% of the time. Inputs that would produce an item with quality in vanilla (e.g.: large eggs in a mayonnaise machine) instead follow the chances above and produce an additional output item.

Several config options are available, as well as support for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] by spacechase0.
[list]
[*]Set the chances for inheriting quality[/*]
[*]Enable cascading downgrades[/*]
[*]Change what happens when producing an item that would have quality in vanilla[/*]
[*]Optionally let cooking ingredients produced in machines and the mill inherit input quality[/*]
[/list]
Requires [i]SMAPI[/i].

To manually install, unzip into a folder in your "Stardew Valley/Mods/" folder.

[line]


I made this mod for myself a while back, but I figured someone else might like it, so here we are.  Buyer beware: Don't expect timely support or updates.

[url=https://github.com/Amish-IT/chance-based-artisan-good-quality]Github[/url]
